claims.text: Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails on the face of the trip record, and one failed limb defeats the whole charge. The driver terminated this trip under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01(d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and the clause states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy the limb. The cancellation fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails too, because the driver never entered the pickup geofence. His own trace never brings him nearer than min_distance_m 284.95 m to the pickup pin, and the derived arrival block returns qualifying_fix_count 0 with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds against the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius. POL-NS-02 deems a driver arrived only where the trace holds at least three consecutive fixes, each at 25 m accuracy or better, inside that radius, and there are none: no admissible arrival, so no chargeable no-show. The trace is IMPAIRED and I disclose it - issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight_multiplier 0.8 - but the impairment does not touch this conclusion: coverage is 100 per cent across 52 fixes with a largest interval of 26 s, and a 285 m miss is an order of magnitude beyond any plausible sampling or accuracy error.

This is the POL-NS-03 fact pattern exactly: a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin. His closest position is 284.95 m from the pickup point - outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius, inside the 400 m ceiling the clause makes the whole test - and he held it through a wait the trip record measures at 6.6 minutes, past the 300 s free waiting period in force. On those facts POL-NS-03 provides that the driver did not arrive, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. (The trace is IMPAIRED, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight 0.8; the 285 m figure is a stationary position measured over a 100 per cent covered trace and survives that discount.)

POL-NS-03 allocates fault from the chat log, and that allocation keeps this cost off the rider. The chat log holds two SYSTEM notifications and not a single message from either party naming an entrance, block, tower or bay, while the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 4. Under POL-NS-03 limb (ii) the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, so any goodwill is a platform-funded payment of 50 per cent of the fee - SGD 2.00 - which is charged to the platform and is never recovered from the rider. Nothing in this dispute is chargeable to the rider.

Even on the narrowest reading - treating this as a waiting-period shortfall rather than a wrong-location case - the fee is still refunded in full. The effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 0.0 seconds, against the 300 s free waiting period in force and a stated shortfall of 300.0 seconds, so POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee not chargeable and refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present. Limb (i) cannot rescue the fee either: EV-ADVIS-00206-01 is MISSING, so there is no traffic_advisory present and populated to permit separate intervals to be summed, and limb (ii) confirms an advisory never excuses a shortfall in any event. (The trace is IMPAIRED, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight 0.8.)

The rider was at the pin, not absent from it. The rider track inside the same trace holds 31 fixes with a mean distance of 15.43 m and a maximum of 22.50 m from the pickup point, every one of them at 0.0 km/h, comfortably inside the 150 m rider-presence radius POL-NS-04 sets for LARGE_VENUE. The rider did the one thing the platform asks - stood at the app-dropped pickup point - and the failed pickup is a driver-side location failure, not a rider no-show. (The trace is IMPAIRED, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight 0.8.)

The GPS impairment is a schema-level tag only and does not cap this remedy at a partial refund. POL-NS-08 scopes 'impaired' to its own limbs, and limb (b) bites only on a sampling gap longer than 120 seconds inside the waiting window or fewer than 6 fixes across it. This trace carries 52 fixes, 100 per cent coverage, an empty gaps list and a largest single interval of 26 seconds, so no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 is met and the closing sentence of POL-NS-08 - the PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling where the deciding fact rests only on impaired evidence - is not engaged. The full refund licensed by POL-NS-03 is therefore available, not a split. (The artifact's own weight is 0.8, issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE.)

Confidence in this ruling is not capped below the platform floor. The deciding position fact is carried by EV-GPS-00206 at weight 0.8, and POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding fact; 0.8 sits above the 0.70 floor, and the bundle mean is context only and is not the cap. No POL-NS-09 trigger is open on these facts: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so there is no repeat-behaviour signal and the fee is not held; POL-GEN-07 has no work to do because POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 licence the outcome. The rider's refund can therefore issue as a monetary ruling rather than being diverted to human review. (EV-GPS-00206 is IMPAIRED, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight 0.8.)

claims.text: This is a wrong-face-of-the-venue case, not an in-radius arrival. The driver's own trace never brings him closer than 284.95 m to the VivoCity pin — outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of POL-NS-02 — but he is stationary at that point across the waiting window and therefore inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, which is exactly the case POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 route to POL-NS-03 rather than to the geofence test. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.8, issue LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median 18 s sampling against a 10 s nominal cadence); I disclose that, and it does not touch a minimum-distance figure, which is unaffected by sample spacing.

The dwell limb of POL-NS-03 is met. The driver's arrival is recorded at 15:12:05 and the trip is terminated at 15:18:40 — a 6.6 minute wait (trip_record.wait_time_min 6.6, about 395 seconds) — against the free waiting period of 300 seconds in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The trace records him stationary at 0.0 km/h at the 285 m point, so the required continuous dwell is satisfied on the GPS clock and not merely on a button tap; the trace is impaired at weight 0.8 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE) and I disclose it, but the stationary window is the one fact the prepass found established beyond argument.

The mislocation is pin ambiguity, and pin ambiguity is charged to the platform, not to this driver. The chat log carries two SYSTEM notifications and nothing else — 'Driver assigned. Meet at VivoCity, Lobby L.' and 'Your driver has arrived' — and not one message from either party naming a block, entrance, tower or bay over the waiting window. The pickup zone has four registered pickup points (trip_record.registered_pickup_points = 4). Under POL-NS-03(ii), where neither party specified a sub-location and registered_pickup_points is 2 or more, the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity and the driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the $4.00 cancellation fee — SGD 2.00 — charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider here and cannot strip the driver of his compensation. Limb (a) requires the chat log to show that the RIDER sent at least one locating or coordinating message during the waiting window; the log holds two SYSTEM messages and nothing from the rider, so limb (a) fails on the face of the artifact and POL-NS-04 is not engaged. The case therefore falls to be decided under POL-NS-03, which is the clause that carries the driver's goodwill.

The arrival marker is not false, and no false-arrival finding may be recorded against this driver. POL-NS-05 catches a marker only where the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or moving at 15 km/h or more, at the marker. The driver's minimum distance across the entire trace is 284.95 m — inside the 300 m line — and he was stationary, not in motion, so neither trigger fires. POL-NS-05's own closing words route a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03. (Trace impaired at weight 0.8, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, disclosed.)

The LOW_SAMPLE_RATE tag does not impair this trace for policy purposes, and nothing on this record escalates. POL-NS-08(b) is met only by a sampling gap longer than 120 s inside the waiting window, fewer than 6 fixes across that window, or an omitted rider_track. The trace reports max_gap_sec 0.0 with an empty gaps array, 52 driver fixes, and a populated rider track of 31 fixes, so no limb of POL-NS-08(a) to (d) fires. The prepass tag is schema-level only: per POL-GEN-02 I disclose it and it down-weights confidence, but it does not engage the escalation route in POL-NS-09(e).

No anti-farming inference may be drawn against this driver, so there is no basis to withhold his payment. On POL-NS-07's check the profile shows driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 1 — below the threshold of 4 — and 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 187, a rate of 0.005 against the 0.08 threshold, so neither limb is met and these fields cannot support an adverse finding. No other profile field is relied on; POL-GEN-01 confines these two counters to this test.

The rider's refund and the driver's payment are not in competition, and the shortfall route cannot swallow the wrong-entrance route. The driver's stationary fixes never enter the arrival geofence, so POL-NS-06's in-geofence dwell arithmetic has no purchase here; POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 both expressly route a driver stationary outside the radius but within 400 m of the pin to POL-NS-03, which fixes both the rider's full refund of the $4.00 and the driver's platform-funded SGD 2.00 goodwill. Under POL-GEN-03 the two figures are independent and are never netted. (Trace cited here is impaired at weight 0.8, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, disclosed; the trip, chat and fare artifacts are all at weight 1.0.)

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver — this decision is issued without human review; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

FINDING. The driver did not reach the pickup point. His own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00206) never brings him closer than 284.95 m to the VivoCity Lobby L pin and returns 0 qualifying in-radius fixes; he waited at the HarbourFront kerb across the road, held position there for about 395 s (the trip record's 6.6-minute wait), and cancelled at 15:18:40 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The rider's track in the same trace places the rider at the pin (mean 15.43 m from it).

OUTCOME. The $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives a $2.00 platform-funded goodwill payment.

WHY THE FEE FALLS. Under POL-NS-02 a driver is deemed arrived only on at least three consecutive fixes, each at 25 m accuracy or better, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius; there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails too: the trip was terminated under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which that limb does not recognise and which the clause treats as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Because the driver's stationary position (284.95 m) lies outside the arrival radius but inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, and the dwell exceeded the 300 s free waiting period in force, POL-NS-03 governs and refunds the fee in full. The driver's own statement — that the map put him at the HarbourFront kerb — says the same thing; it carries no weight multiplier, but it agrees with the instrument evidence.

WHY THE DRIVER IS STILL PAID. Neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay in the chat log (EV-CHAT-00206 holds two SYSTEM notifications and no party message), and the pickup zone has 4 registered pickup points (EV-TRIP-00206). POL-NS-03(ii) therefore attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity and pays the driver 50% of the $4.00 fee = $2.00, funded by the platform and never recovered from the rider. Under POL-GEN-03 the $4.00 refund and the $2.00 goodwill are independent and are never netted. The monetary effect is $6.00, below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes on issue.

EVIDENCE WEIGHT (POL-GEN-02). EV-GPS-00206 carries the deciding position fact and is impaired at weight 0.8 (issue LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, median 18 s cadence against a 10 s nominal). The discount is disclosed and does not disturb the finding: the impairment concerns sample spacing, not position, and a 285 m miss is far outside any sampling or accuracy effect. The artifact is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08 (largest gap 0.0 s, 52 driver fixes, rider track present), so no PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation engages. Confidence is capped at the trace's 0.8, above the 0.70 floor. EV-ADVIS-00206-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and carries no fact; its absence is why POL-NS-06(i) interval-summing is unavailable, and nothing here needs it. No referral is produced: POL-NS-05 does not fire (the marker is not false), and the POL-NS-01 reason-code referral applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, which is not this case.

CLAIMS. Driver claims on the wrong-face position, the 285 m/400 m ceiling, the 6.6-minute dwell against the 300 s free waiting period, and the $2.00 pin-ambiguity goodwill are accepted and they decide the case. The driver's point that POL-NS-04 is not engaged is accepted (the rider sent no locating message, so limb (a) fails), and the rider's own track does not change the outcome. The driver's point that the arrival marker is not false is accepted: 284.95 m is inside POL-NS-05's 300 m line and he was stationary, so no false-arrival referral is recorded and POL-NS-03 governs. The driver's POL-NS-08 and escalation points are accepted. The driver's anti-farming point is accepted (no_show_terminations_30d 1, rate 0.005, both below POL-NS-07's thresholds), but POL-NS-07's 80% payout ($3.20) is not the payment here: POL-NS-03 displaces the no-show route, so the driver's payment is the $2.00 goodwill, not $3.20. Rider claims that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (d) fail, that this is the POL-NS-03 fact pattern, that fault allocation under POL-NS-03(ii) keeps the cost off the rider, that the LOW_SAMPLE_RATE tag is schema-level only and does not engage the partial-refund ceiling, and that confidence sits at 0.8 above the floor are all accepted. The rider's separate point that he was present at the pin is accepted as fact, but POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate him because limb (a) requires a rider message and there is none — the full refund comes from POL-NS-03, not POL-NS-04. The rider's alternative POL-NS-06 shortfall route was discarded at the mechanical stage for citing the absent advisory artifact without naming its issue code; it is not relied on and would in any event reach the same refund.

To the rider (RDR-02660): the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00206 is refunded to you in full. To the driver (DRV-00337): the fee does not stand, but you receive a platform-funded goodwill payment of SGD 2.00, which is never recovered from the rider.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00206, weight 1.0) records the driver terminating the trip at 15:18:40 with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, after the recorded arrival at 15:12:05 and a wait of 6.6 minutes against the free waiting period of 300 seconds in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec), with a cancellation fee of SGD 4.00. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00206) places the driver stationary and never nearer than 284.95 m to the VivoCity Lobby L pin, across 100 percent coverage and 52 fixes.

WHY THE FEE IS NOT CHARGEABLE. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs. Limb (d) fails on the face of the trip record: DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and is not one of RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. Limb (b) fails too: there is no qualifying in-radius fix, so POL-NS-02 cannot deem an arrival.

WHY THE OUTCOME IS A FULL REFUND PLUS GOODWILL. The driver's stationary position lies outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling, and POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 both route exactly that fact pattern to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-03 refunds the SGD 4.00 in full. It then allocates the mislocation from the chat log (EV-CHAT-00206, weight 1.0), which holds only two SYSTEM notifications and nothing from either party naming a block, entrance, tower or bay, against four registered pickup points (trip_record.registered_pickup_points = 4). Under POL-NS-03(ii) the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, so the driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee - SGD 2.00 - charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The refund and the goodwill are independent and are not netted (POL-GEN-03).

CLAIMS ADDRESSED. The rider's POL-NS-01 claims (limbs (d) and (b) fail) are accepted and set the direction of the refund. Both sides' POL-NS-03 claims are accepted: the wrong-face-of-the-venue pattern is made out on the distance test, and the pin-ambiguity allocation gives the driver SGD 2.00 rather than nothing. On POL-NS-04 (raised by both sides): the rider did stand at the pin - the rider track shows 31 fixes with a mean of 15.43 m and a maximum of 22.50 m, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius - but limb (a) fails because the chat log contains no rider message, so POL-NS-04 exonerates nobody and cannot strip the driver's goodwill; the full refund does not depend on it. On POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is not false. The driver's closest fix, 284.95 m, is inside the 300 m line and he was stationary, so neither trigger fires and no false-arrival referral arises. On POL-NS-07: it is not engaged. POL-NS-01 is not satisfied and POL-NS-03 displaces it, so no 80 percent compensation is payable (the SGD 3.20 figure in the fare breakdown is not due); the anti-farming check is clean in any event (no_show_terminations_30d of 1, well under 4, and 1/187 = 0.005, well under 0.08), and the driver's SGD 2.00 is POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill, not POL-NS-07 compensation. On POL-NS-06 / the shortfall route: it has no purchase, because the driver never entered the geofence and so there are no separate in-geofence intervals to sum and no shortfall to compute; the absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00206-01, MISSING, weight 0.0) bears on nothing here, and the rider claim resting on it without naming its issue code was discarded at the mechanical check.

WEIGHT AND CONFIDENCE. The fact that decides the goodwill is the driver's position, and it is carried by EV-GPS-00206 at weight 0.8, issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median 18 s sampling against a 10 s nominal cadence). That impairment is disclosed and named (POL-GEN-02(1) and (3)), and the finding survives the discount: a minimum-distance figure does not depend on sample spacing, coverage is 100 percent across 52 fixes, and the largest interval is 26 s. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped at 0.8, above the 0.70 floor, so no POL-NS-09(a) escalation. The schema-level tag is not a POL-NS-08(b) impairment - no gap over 120 s, more than 6 fixes, and the rider track is present - so POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged either. No other escalation trigger fires: on POL-NS-09(c) and (d) both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0 and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0.

EXECUTION. The total monetary effect is SGD 6.00 (SGD 4.00 refund plus SGD 2.00 compensation), below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue. Both parties retain the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

REFERRALS. None. No clause produces one on these facts: the arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire; the anti-farming check does not trip, so POL-NS-07 directs nothing into a packet; and POL-NS-01's driver-education referral for a mis-selected reason code attaches only to the inside-radius branch, which is not this case.

CLAIMS ADDRESSED. The rider's POL-NS-01 claims (limbs (d) and (b) fail) are accepted and set the direction of the refund. ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver, this dispute is decided as follows.

THE FEE. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider is refunded in full.

WHY. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four of its limbs hold. Limb (b) fails: the driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00206) never places him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius around the VivoCity pin - his closest approach across the whole trace is 284.95 m, and the arrival test returns zero qualifying in-radius fixes (POL-NS-02). Limb (d) fails: the trip record records the trip terminated under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01(d) states in terms that this code is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy the limb. The fee is therefore not chargeable.

THE GOVERNING CLAUSE. The driver was stationary for the required dwell (trip_record.wait_time_min 6.6, about 395 s) at a point outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pickup pin (284.95 m), against the 300 s free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-03 makes the 400 m ceiling the whole test, and on these facts the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the fee is refunded to the rider in full - SGD 4.00.

THE DRIVER'S PAYMENT. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00206) holds two SYSTEM notifications and no message from either party naming an entrance, block, tower or bay, and the pickup zone has four registered pickup points (registered_pickup_points = 4). Under POL-NS-03(ii) the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 per cent of the SGD 4.00 fee - SGD 2.00 - charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. Per POL-GEN-03 the rider's refund and the driver's payment are independent and are never netted against each other.

CLAIMS ANSWERED. The driver's claims that this is a wrong-face-of-the-venue case decided under POL-NS-03, that his stationary wait met the required dwell, that the mislocation is pin ambiguity, that POL-NS-04 is not engaged, that POL-NS-05's false-arrival trigger does not fire, and that POL-NS-06's in-geofence shortfall arithmetic has no purchase because his fixes never entered the geofence, are accepted and lead to the same outcome. On POL-NS-05: the closest approach is 284.95 m, inside the 300 m line, and he was stationary at the marker rather than travelling at 15 km/h or above, so the arrival marker is not false and no false-arrival referral is recorded. The driver's POL-NS-07 point (no anti-farming pattern: no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against completed_trips_30d = 187, a rate of 0.005) is accepted as far as it goes, but POL-NS-07 does not fix his payout here: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied and POL-NS-03 displaces it, so the SGD 2.00 is the POL-NS-03(ii) platform goodwill, not the 80 per cent compensation of POL-NS-07. The rider's claims that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (d) fail, that POL-NS-03 requires a full refund, that the goodwill is platform-funded and never recovered from the rider, and that the GPS impairment is schema-level only, are accepted. The rider's POL-NS-04 claim is accepted only in part: the rider track (31 fixes, mean 15.43 m, maximum 22.50 m from the pin) shows the rider stood at the app-dropped pickup point, but POL-NS-04 does not apply because its limb (a) requires a locating message sent by the rider in the chat log and there is none.

EVIDENCE WEIGHT AND CONFIDENCE. The deciding position fact rests on EV-GPS-00206, weight 0.8, issue code LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median 18 s sampling against a 10 s nominal cadence). I name the artifact, its weight and its issue code: the finding survives the discount, because 52 fixes at 100 per cent coverage with a largest interval of 26 s cannot move a stationary position 285 m. The tag is schema-level only - it meets no limb of POL-NS-08(a) to (d) (no gap, well over 6 fixes, rider track present) - so it neither caps the ruling at a partial refund nor engages escalation under POL-NS-09(e); it caps confidence under POL-GEN-02(2) at the artifact's 0.8, which is above the platform-wide 0.70 floor. The bundle mean is context only and is not the cap. The rider's waiting-period-shortfall claim under POL-NS-06 was discarded at the mechanical check for citing the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-00206-01 without naming its issue code, and it is not reinstated; POL-NS-06 is not the route to this refund.

ESCALATION AND EXECUTION. No escalation: confidence is 0.80, at or above the 0.70 floor; there are no repeat no-show disputes between these parties (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0); and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. The monetary effect is SGD 6.00 (SGD 4.00 refund plus SGD 2.00 goodwill), below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this was a pin-ambiguity pickup at a large venue. The $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives a separate platform-funded goodwill payment of $2.00. The two figures are independent and are not offset.

What the record shows. The booking's pickup pin is VivoCity, Level 1, Lobby L (1.2644, 103.8221), a LARGE_VENUE zone. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00206) never brings him closer than 284.95 m to that pin, and his recorded speed there is 0.0 km/h. The trip was accepted 15:03:30, his 'arrived' marker is 15:12:05, and he terminated the trip at 15:18:40 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, a wait the trip record (EV-TRIP-00206) measures at 6.6 minutes against the 300-second free waiting period in force.

The charge does not stand. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails: a stationary position 284.95 m from the pin is outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, so POL-NS-02 does not deem the driver arrived. Limb (d) fails independently: DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own statement that he could not find the rider, and it is not one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises. The $4.00 fee (EV-FARE-00206; platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd $4.00) is therefore refunded to the rider in full.

The route is POL-NS-03. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, POL-NS-03 governs. Neither party named a block, entrance, tower or bay - the chat log (EV-CHAT-00206) holds only two SYSTEM notifications - and the venue has 4 registered pickup points, so the mislocation is attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party. The driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50% of the $4.00 fee, i.e. SGD 2.00 (EV-FARE-00206 money block). It is charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.

The rider's POL-NS-04 claim is accepted as to presence but does not exonerate the rider. The rider's position is well established - 31 fixes, mean 15.43 m and maximum 22.50 m from the pin, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius. But POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires the chat log to show a locating message sent by the rider, and the log contains no rider message at all. POL-NS-04 therefore does not apply and does not strip the driver's goodwill; the refund does not depend on it.

No false-arrival referral. POL-NS-05 catches the marker only where the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or moving at 15 km/h or more, at the marker. The driver was 284.95 m away and stationary, so neither trigger fires and no false-arrival record is entered. Nor is there a reason-code education referral: POL-NS-01 directs that only where the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, which they do not.

Evidence weight and confidence. EV-GPS-00206 is impaired at weight 0.8, issue LOW_SAMPLE_RATE (median 18 s sampling against a 10 s nominal cadence). That is disclosed, and the finding survives the discount: coverage is 100% across 52 driver fixes, the largest interval is 26 s, the gaps list is empty, so none of POL-NS-08's own limbs (a) to (d) is met and neither the PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling nor POL-NS-09(e) is engaged; a 285 m miss is far beyond any sampling or accuracy error. The deciding position fact rests on EV-GPS-00206, so confidence is capped at 0.80, above the platform's 0.70 floor; the case is decided here rather than sent to human review. EV-TRIP-00206, EV-CHAT-00206 and EV-FARE-00206 all carry weight 1.0. No POL-NS-09 trigger is open: the profiles' counterparty-dispute counts are 0, rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming counters are 1 of 187, far below both limbs.

The rider's POL-NS-06 waiting-period-shortfall claim was discarded by the referee: it cited the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00206-01 (weight 0.0) without naming its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. It is not needed, because POL-NS-03 already produces the full refund.

Execution. The monetary effect is $4.00 + $2.00 = $6.00, below the $8.00 automatic-execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so this provisional ruling executes on issue unless either party appeals under POL-GEN-04.

This trace carries 52 fixes, 100 per cent coverage, an empty gaps list and a largest single interval of 26 seconds, so no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 is met and the closing sentence of POL-NS-08 - the PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling where the deciding fact rests only on impaired evidence - is not engaged. Confidence in this ruling is not capped below the platform floor. The deciding position fact is carried by EV-GPS-00206 at weight 0.8, and POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding fact; 0.8 sits above the 0.70 floor, and the bundle mean is context only and is not the cap. No POL-NS-09 trigger is open on these facts: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so there is no repeat-behaviour signal and the fee is not held; POL-GEN-07 has no work to do because POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 licence the outcome. The rider's refund can therefore issue as a monetary ruling rather than being diverted to human review. (EV-GPS-00206 is IMPAIRED, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, weight 0.8.)

This is a wrong-face-of-the-venue case, not an in-radius arrival. The driver's own trace never brings him closer than 284.95 m to the VivoCity pin — outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of POL-NS-02 — but he is stationary at that point across the waiting window and therefore inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, which is exactly the case POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-02 route to POL-NS-03 rather than to the geofence test.
